title: A property of a representation of a free group
coverage: Citation from the literature; no DOI, not checked online
annotation:
The example in notes/Examples and Section 3 of the manuscript: $\mat1201$ and $\mat1021$ generate a free group.

We give the now-standard proof by ping-pong on the cones $\abs{x} > \abs{y}$ and $\abs{y} > \abs{x}$, and have not compared it with Sanov's original argument.
